messages.subject: Models with problematic seeds
parts:
The last Jenkins model build failure was caused by a bad seed. I'll
post the problematic models with seeds as we come across them. They
might indicate a misspecified model, a bug, or some other issue.

We're having trouble with this model:
models/bugs_examples/vol2/beetles/beetles_probit
with seed:
1073571327

the sampled beta value is problematic.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: Models with problematic seeds
parts:
On 7/10/12 12:42 AM, Daniel Lee wrote:
> vol1/dogs, seed=1985516974
>
> By the way, I am seeing a seg fault with some of the models

Stan should catch problems before segfaults, so there's a problem
even if the models aren't right. Can you recreate a seg fault?
If so, let's track this down tomorrow.

If Stan segfaults, I believe it'll crash R around it.

> when I
> shift parameters to transformed parameters.

I don't see how you could shift parameters to transformed
params. If one parameter was a transform of the other,
the original sampler shouldn't be able to move. If not,
you shouldn't be able to shift to transformed.

I'd guess the problem is in initialization of transformed params.

- Bob
